text: At N=128 seeds 22-23, force gains only about 0.02-0.03 between steps 1000 and 3000 while val_mse_ratio falls about 1.1 decades (0.64-1.0 to 0.067-0.079). Over the same steps, is the N=64 seeds 22-23 force gain per decade of val_mse_ratio decline (about 0.07-0.09 total) higher? That would mean N=128 force grows more slowly per unit of loss reduction, not just later.
